text:
in the spirit of Christian Christmas.

Nothing is cleaner than money,

or more generous, or stronger.

Money opens every door;

it is the key to a merry life,

the rod of miracles,

the instrument of resurrection.

It gives you the necessary and the unnecessary,

bread and joy.

If your wife is sick you can cure her,

if she's a beast you can pay to have her killed.

Money washes your hands

of injustice and crime,

keeps you from work, absolves you of living.

With money in your pocket you can be yourself,

money is freedom.

If you want one woman and another and another, buy them,

if you want an island, buy it,

if you want a crowd, buy it.

(It is the cleanest verb in the language: to buy.)

I have money means I have myself.

I am mine and I am yours

in this marvelous world without resistance.

Giving money is giving love.


Hallelujah, believers, join in worship of the slandered calf

of gold, and may its mother's beautiful udders suckle us!

translation.title: Let Us Sing to Money
